description: Fused port-congestion signal for a port (UN/LOCODE): effective level (mild/moderate/severe), expected added wait in days (for ETA-band widening), a 0–1 confidence, and the independent readings behind it: measured vessel waiting times, port-call throughput and AIS wait/density. With Navo Tokens this costs 10 tokens per call; an empty answer is free.
name: port_congestion
